channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Remote & Worldwide, weekly digest. Released weekly: each Sunday's drop carries one entry per grant added in the week before it (Sunday to Saturday). A call that closes before its drop goes out is not sent; the website lists those.

item.title: Humboldt Residency Programme 2027, "Oceanic Horizons: The Future of our Blue Planet" (funded six-week residency for researchers, creatives and practitioners) (closes 14 Dec)
item.description:
Alexander von Humboldt Foundation
Deadline: 14 Dec 2026
Award: Monthly allowance for the six-week residency (figure not published: researchers get standard Humboldt fellowship rates, creatives and practitioners a competitive honorarium), travel allowance to and from Germany, accommodation at Schloss Wiepersdorf and a Berlin aparthotel, and a budget for public formats. No family allowance. No application fee.

Each year the Humboldt Foundation brings twelve people from research, the arts and civil society together to work on one topic and find new ways of communicating it to audiences beyond academia. The 2027 topic is Oceanic Horizons: The Future of our Blue Planet.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: ligeti zentrum Artists and Scientists in Residence 2027, Where Sound Shapes Space (Hamburg; EUR 1,200 a month plus accommodation) (closes 10 Jan 2027)
item.description:
ligeti zentrum (Hamburg University of Music and Theatre, HAW Hamburg and partners)
Deadline: 10 Jan 2027, 23:59 CET
Award: Scholarship of EUR 1,200 net per month for the residency, plus accommodation in Hamburg, a workspace, use of the Production Lab, basic technical support and professional documentation. Travel is not mentioned. No application fee mentioned.

Fifth round of the ligeti zentrum's artistic-scientific residency in Hamburg. Each resident joins one of four running projects on sound and space.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Smartwear Revolution Artist-in-Residence 2027 (University of Alberta): In-Person and Virtual Residencies (closes 15 Dec)
item.description:
Co-Designing a Smartwear Revolution, University of Alberta (Art & Design Working Group), funded by the New Frontiers in Research Fund
Deadline: 15 Dec 2026
Award: In-person: CAD 12,000 covering artist fee, materials, travel, accommodation and production. Virtual: CAD 8,000 covering materials and production. Stage-2 interviewees receive a CAD 100 honorarium. No application fee.

Two artist residencies with Co-Designing a Smartwear Revolution, a University of Alberta research network of 100+ researchers in textile science, AI and robotics building smart garments with sensors and actuators.

Apply on the organiser's site

item.title: Eyebeam AGENCY Virtual Residency, Fall 2026 (US-based artists)
item.description: Eyebeam · deadline 11 Oct 2026 · USD 2,000 stipend for each of six selected artists, plus weekly residency programming, mentorship with Eyebeam alumni and visiting professionals, technical consultation, and access to tools and expertise through Eyebeam's network. No application fee (via Submittable).

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound residency - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.
